versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.

- Version number updated from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
- No changes to code or documentation content.

Initial release of the cognitive neuroscience paper reader skill.

- Reads and summarizes cognitive neuroscience and experimental psychology papers (PDF or plain text).
- Extracts structured notes: hypothesis, methods, participants, tasks, statistics, effect sizes, results, and limitations.
- Handles empirical studies, reviews, and theory/methods papers on topics like attention, working memory, and decision-making.
- Provides a glossary of domain terms and a critical reading section.
- Clearly marks unreported statistics or results and avoids inventing information.
